description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling party lookup, refresh, and UI toggling within the application. It appears to be part of a web application related to party management. The code interacts with DOM elements, utilizes jQuery for UI manipulation, and is licensed under the Apache 2.0 license.

methods.name: lookupParty
methods.description: Sets the form action to a provided URL if either partyId or userLoginId fields are filled, indicating a lookup request.

methods.name: refreshInfo
methods.description: Resets lookup flags and submits the form to refresh party information.

methods.name: collapseFindPartyOptions
methods.description: Toggles the collapse/expand state of option panels in the UI for party search options, using jQuery.
